Hi Marcus —

We're moving forward with a short intake for the Redwood integration and need to schedule a combined walkthrough covering: SOC 2 scope, an outline of the upcoming penetration test plan, and DPA clauses that affect our data retention. Target audience: our security engineer (cc'd) and procurement.

Can you propose two 60-minute windows next week? Prefer: late afternoons (16:00–18:00 CET) or early mornings UTC-friendly. Also, please share a short agenda and any evidence mapping you expect us to prepare — that will speed up the review.

We are aiming to get this done before our vendor approval board on May 6, so the earlier the better.

Thanks,

Jordan —

Thanks for the context and the timeline. We can do a focused 60-minute intake that hits those three topics. Proposed windows (CEST / UTC equivalencies included):
- Wed May 4, 16:00–17:00 CEST (14:00–15:00 UTC)
- Thu May 5, 17:00–18:00 CEST (15:00–16:00 UTC)

If neither works, we can do Tue May 3, 09:00–10:00 CEST (07:00–08:00 UTC) — earlier slot.

Agenda (draft):
1) 5m intro & objectives
2) 15m SOC 2 scope & evidence map (we'll share a short evidence mapping doc)
3) 20m pen test approach & fallbacks (what to expect in scheduling/timing)
4) 10m DPA clauses & retention questions
5) 10m actions & timeline to vendor board

I've attached a lightweight agenda and an evidence map template so you can see what we'd like to preview ahead of the call. Laura (copied) will run the SOC 2 portion and Priyom will handle DPA/contract touchpoints.

Let me know which slot you prefer and we'll lock the calendar and send a bridge.

Best,
Marcus Lin
